candidate.design: Job.create allocates one 5 + payload buffer and points options.message at the payload suffix. The worker passes that storage to ClientDuplex.stageOwnedMessageStorage. Identity and compression fallback transfer the exact allocation to PendingMessage; actual compression keeps the compressed output and frees the original.

scope.workload: SharedChannel shared-unary persistent round trip, 262144-byte request and response

benchmark_method.schedule: five ABBA rounds; baseline, candidate, candidate, baseline
benchmark_method.host: shared host with unrelated load; no CPU pinning
benchmark_method.metric: ns_per_roundtrip from the benchmark result record

correctness.job_test: a Job reserves exactly 5 + payload bytes and points options.message at storage[5..]
correctness.full_validation_run: shared-unary with full payload equality passed

layout_note: An earlier candidate stored outbound_ownership.OwnedMessage inline and grew Job to the same size as StreamCall. A test allocator keyed on @sizeOf(StreamCall) then locked on a Job allocation and deadlocked. Keeping owned_message as ?[]u8 preserves the original Job layout and avoids that collision.
